entries.name: Killing Frost
entries.displayTemplate: {value}% chance to freeze the target on hit
entries.notes: SHIPPED, id kept verbatim per naming.v1.json idNamespaces.affixFamilies (g.affliction existingFamilies = 'the 20 status.apply families'). status="freeze" is StatusCatalogBootstrap's working UnityCc row, family "elemental" — the ONE status-family mutex actually implemented (atom-catalog-ssot.md §5): freeze, cold and poison/jala share it, so a target already frozen cannot also be chilled or poisoned until it clears. Only `status` is authored; `duration` and `level` are DERIVED from powerBand via bands.v1.json's statusMagnitudeAndDuration two-ladder rule (chance at r=1.75, duration mandatory at r=1.4) — FA2's own param surface (AtomKindRegistry status.apply) only ever reads status/duration/level, and duration/level are magnitudes seed-contract §3 forbids authoring. `roles` is the afflict column's nonzero cells (ssot-affixes.md §4.3), translated sense-utility->sense / manipulator-offense->manipulator / jewel-minor->-a and -b — identical to g.on-hit's roles list because the two columns share the same nonzero roles exactly. powerBand kept low: a hard CC lock must not compound the way a damage rider can as its trigger chance climbs.

entries.name: Venom Graft
entries.displayTemplate: {value}% chance to poison the target on hit
entries.notes: SHIPPED, id kept verbatim. Authored deliberately thin because status="poison" is incoherent across three subsystems, exactly as this lane's brief and atom-catalog-ssot.md §5 both flag: category dot, family elemental (it sits in the freeze/cold/jala mutex above), kind UnityCc (the battle-side CC check tests Kind, not category). This entry names only the status reference — no element param, no category-specific claim, no reliance on the DoT tick, the mutex, or the CC lock individually — so it does not need, and does not get, reconciled against whichever of the three readings turns out true. That reconciliation is explicitly out of this partition's scope, per the brief.

entries.name: Hypnotic Pollen
entries.displayTemplate: {value}% chance to mesmerize the target on hit
entries.notes: SHIPPED, id kept verbatim. status="hypno" is a working UnityCc row, family "cc" — unlike `freezing` above, it does NOT sit in the elemental mutex, so it stacks/replaces on its own terms. powerBand deliberately held at the lowest rung: turning a zombie to fight for the caster is the single strongest thing any status in this catalog can do, and a chance-based on-hit rider must not let that compound the way a medium- or high-band rider would.

entries.name: Wilting Touch
entries.displayTemplate: {value}% chance to wither the target on hit
entries.notes: SHIPPED, id kept verbatim — atom-family-library.md §3.4 calls this one "the OverTime default". Fully functional today with no missing payload half, unlike its `bloodletting` sibling below: it applies, ticks, and deals its damage end to end.

entries.name: Bloodletting
entries.displayTemplate: {value}% chance to inflict bloodletting on hit
entries.notes: SHIPPED, id kept verbatim, but PARTIAL per this lane's brief and atom-family-library.md §3.4: status="leech" ticks its damage half only — the heal-the-caster half of the payload was never built. Authored anyway under the owner's 2026-08-22 decision to complete these payloads inside this program. Tagged offensive rather than defensive because the half that runs today is a plain DoT with no lifesteal-back-to-caster effect yet; do not confuse this family with `atom.lifesteal` in g.on-hit, which is a resource.delta rider that already heals on the wearer's own hit.

entries.name: Spore Infestation
entries.displayTemplate: {value}% chance to infest the target with spores on hit
entries.notes: SHIPPED, id kept verbatim — one of the five contagion families in the group (`blighting`/`rotting`/`sparking`/`marking`/`sporing` share this exact shape, none of which this partition also authors, to stay near the ~7-family target). powerBand held at low: atom-catalog-ssot.md §5 states contagion cannot spread at all today because the engine passes `board: null`, so the headline mechanic (spreading) is dormant even though the base per-tick status is live. Authored anyway since the functioning half is real; the spread failure is a runtime gap, not a reason to withhold the family.

Authored per this lane's brief — author against what works, flag what does not — and per atom-family-library.md §3.4's owner decision to wire the three missing branches (`ember`/`jala`/`kelp`) inside this program. This row imports and prices cleanly but binds nowhere until that branch exists.

entries.name: Butter Seal
entries.displayTemplate: {value}% chance to butter the target on hit
entries.notes: AUTHORED 2026-09-06 to close a real corpus gap, not a new design. This family id is referenced by shipped content (base-types/infusion/humanoid/*-a.json and *-b.json implicits, unique earthen-bastion-70 "Holding Thresher" (powerAxis control, fixedAtoms[0] at band high)) and is listed in classes.v2.json implicitSlates.infusion.legalFamilies, but no affix-families/*.json entry ever defined it: atom.sporing's own notes above record why -- "one of the five contagion families in the group (blighting/rotting/sparking/marking/sporing share this exact shape, NONE OF WHICH THIS PARTITION ALSO AUTHORS, to stay near the ~7-family target)". The partition deferred them as already-shipped; nothing else picked them up. status="butter" is not inferred from the family name -- atom-family-library.md SS3.4's family/status table names the pairing directly ("buttering . freezing . chilling . venomous . mesmerizing | butter . freeze . cold . poison . hypno | C | shipped"), and StatusCatalogBootstrap.cs registers that exact id (StatusKind.UnityCc, family "cc", StatusL2bCategory.Cc, Replace). powerBand follows the rule the seven entries above already hold to without exception, read off StatusCatalogBootstrap's own StatusL2bCategory rather than invented here: Cc -> low (freezing/mesmerizing/entangling), Dot -> medium (venomous/withering/bloodletting), Contagion -> low (sporing). No magnitude is authored -- bands.v1.json's statusMagnitudeAndDuration two-ladder derives chance at r=1.75 and duration at r=1.4 from this band, and seed-contract.md SS3 forbids an author writing either. Fully live end to end, unlike its `entangling` neighbour: EffectAtomCatalog.Generated.cs ships fx.butter_on_hit / fx.icd_butter / fx.clear_butter and MatchButterSecondaryPlugin grants it in a real match, so this is the one CC family in the file with a working injector path today. Flavour drawn from the butter/corn/gold register the shipped grant id `golden-butter` already uses, deliberately away from freezing's frost words.
